plain_english_policy: Offering tax credits for child care is generally seen as a progressive measure to support working families and reduce inequality.
evidence_quote: Provide tax credits or grants to businesses that offer child care services to employees.
review_reason: This policy targets economic equity for low-income workers (progressive), but the mechanism is a business subsidy which can be viewed as fiscally conservative. The net ideological direction is mixed or context-dependent depending on funding source and eligibility criteria.
